messages: Mia: Quick design question — should we aim for parity of required indicators across the console or vary by surface? thinking about compact lists vs full-detail forms. also: destructive confirmations (typed-confirm vs modal + undo). cc @Sam & @Jordan Sam: For lists/tables I'd vote a subtle asterisk — stays compact. For full forms (create/edit flow) the pill 'Required' works better for clarity and accessibility. asterisk alone is ambiguous to some non-dev stakeholders. :thinking_face: Jordan: Accessibility note: screen readers don't always convey asterisks. If we rely on visual-only markers we must add aria-required or sr-only text. example:``` ``` Ana: On errors — inline error next to field is best for quick recovery. But we should add a top-level error summary for long multi-step forms so users can jump to issues. inline + summary combo > only one. Kevin: For destructive actions — typed-confirm ("type DELETE") is good for irreversible operations (delete org, purge data). For small deletions (remove item) a modal + undo toast feels less painful and keeps conversion higher. also typed-confirm blocks screen-reader users less consistently, need to ensure alternative (aria-live confirmation) exists. Priya: Copy nit: if we show a pill, keep it light: 'Required' not 'This field is required'. For error copy, start with the problem: 'Enter a valid email' > then hint. short + actionable. Mia: Re: asterisk vs pill: proposal — default to 'asterisk + aria-required' for inline compact fields, pill for full-length forms or when the requiredness is important to surface (billing, security settings). Also add hover tooltip on asterisk for clarity in complex flows. Sam: +1 to tooltip. small CSS suggestion for pill: `.required-pill { background: #fff6f0; color: #8a3b00; font-size: 12px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 12px; }` keeps it low-visual-weight but readable. Jordan: Edgecase: when a form has mostly required fields, showing 'Required' everywhere is noise. In that case show single note at top: 'All fields required unless marked optional' and only mark optional fields. accessibility: announce that note at form focus. Ana: Can we avoid typed-confirm for mobile where typing is painful? fallback modal + explicit checkbox + undo might be better on mobile. add to platform guidance. Kevin: Action items: Design to produce two mocks: (1) compact table/list with asterisk + tooltip pattern, (2) detailed form with required-pill + inline errors + top summary. Also docs for destructive actions: typed-confirm reserved for irreversible, mobile-friendly alternatives recorded. Mia: Perfect — I'll add to the sprint board and tag you all on the card. If anyone has microcopy suggestions drop them in the card before EOD. :thumbsup:
